values: 一名勇猛的战士，他能破坏敌人的护甲，然后将其征服。
A brave Warrior who can destroy enemies' Phys DEF and vanish them.
You just made the best choice!
无可匹敌的秘诀就是不断变强
The secret to being invincible is to always get stronger.
利斧将斩下最强者的头颅。
Hah, a keen axe will take the head of even the strongest warrior.
哼，要打吗？那可得好好打磨了。
Heh, you wanna tango? Gotta sharpen my axe. Hahahahaa.
哼，别想钻空子，我没有死角。
Heh, don't think about finding a weakness, I have none.
感谢馈赠，这对我意义非凡。
I'm grateful for this blessing, it means a lot to me.
My joints are feeling a bit rusty...
斧头也要好好磨一下了
My axe needs a polish too.
These decorations need to be even wilder!
Let's drink and be merry tonight!
Come on, everyone, let's make some noise!
克鲁格花了很久才习惯视野不全的感觉，为了不让敌人钻空子，在那段时间他出招比之前更加狠戾了。
It took Kruger a long time to adapt to his diminished vision. To prevent his enemies from taking advantage of it, his attacks were especially savage during that period.
绝大多数人不知道，克鲁格年轻时曾试图竞争族长，但惨败给了兄长。
Most people are unaware that Kruger once challenged his tribe leader in his youth, only to be brutally defeated by his elder brother.
据说，有时克鲁格醒来时会戴错眼罩的方向，然后误以为自己变成了全盲。
They say that Kruger sometimes awakens with his eyepatch over the wrong eye, which briefly scares him into thinking that he has gone completely blind.
克鲁格吃任何食物都不会切开，如果实在太大块，他会考虑撕开。
Kruger never cuts his food into bite-sized portions. If his food is too big to eat, he always tear it apart first.
克鲁格的衣着颜色不利于隐蔽，他不畏惧，甚至欢迎人来挑战和寻仇。
Kruger's attire is ill-suited for covert operations, which suits him just fine. A fearless warrior, he welcomes all challengers and vengeance-seekers.
克鲁格的斧刃上常出现豁口，他是武器商人的常客。
Kruger's axe is often chipped in battle, making him a favorite among blacksmiths and weapon dealers.
克鲁格对于强弱有自己的判断，因为这与黑嚎传统观念相悖，所以他从不说出来。
Kruger has his own way of judging strength and weakness, though it goes against the traditions of the Grimmaw Clan. As a result, he never mentions it.
像每一个蛮血那样，克鲁格以战斗为荣，包括那些因为对手过于强大而惨败的战斗。
Like any other Mauler, Kruger seeks glory through battle. This is especially true of battles in which his opponents are too powerful to defeat.
克鲁格是一场保卫氏族荣誉的战斗中失去了一只眼睛，从此之后他性格大变。
Kruger lost his eye in battle while defending the honor of his clan. Ever since then, his personality has undergone drastic changes.
克鲁格曾经挑战过布鲁特斯，二人过了十几招后，布鲁特斯便战胜了他。

Kruger once challenged Brutus to a duel. After a dozen or so attacks, Brutus easily defeated him. "That was a good fight, Kruger, but you still have a long way to go before you can best me,"  Brutus declared before helping him up.
